sections.title: Turning a verb into a method
sections.content: Turn a familiar verb into a noun with -ás/-és (gyakorol -> gyakorlás, "practice"; ismétel -> ismétlés, "repetition"; hallgat -> hallgatás, "listening"), then attach -val/-vel, the same "with" ending from Cooking, to say you learn BY doing that activity.

items.english: I learn new words by practicing.

items.spanish: Hallgatással és ismétléssel tanulom a kiejtést.
items.english: I learn pronunciation by listening and repeating.

sections.content: The -ás/-és noun always starts from the verb's 3rd-person-singular form you already know (gyakorol, ismétel, hallgat, olvas) — just add -ás or -és, then -val/-vel exactly as you would on any other noun.
